name: Scout Coal Source

observation_sources.meaning: Ray observation sees coal ore.
Local grid contains coal ore.
Profile-provided marker audits deterministic coal placement but does not satisfy the verifier.

name: Collect Coal

name: Build Lit Shelter
instruction: Build or occupy a small lit shelter area.

observation_sources.meaning: Local grid contains a torch.
Local grid contains enough enclosing solid blocks.
Player location has enough effective light.
Player location has sufficiently low effective sky light or blocked sky exposure.
Blocked sky exposure can satisfy the shelter enclosure proxy.

name: Survive First Night
instruction: Remain alive through the target night interval.

observation_sources.meaning: World time is in or past the target night interval.
Elapsed time covers the survival interval.
Agent remains alive.
Runner-derived night-survival flag.
